subject: Hydrolytics — vendor enrollment, PO requirements and VAT clarifications
messages:
From: Nisha Rao <nisha.rao@hydrolytics.io>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@hydrolytics.io
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Vendor enrollment request — Redwood Inference (AP onboarding)

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the productive kickoff earlier. Procurement has asked that we formally enroll Redwood Inference in our AP system before the first invoice is released. Attached is our standard AP enrollment form and the onboarding checklist. Can you please provide the following so we can create your vendor record?

- Legal / remittance name exactly as it should appear on the vendor record
- EU VAT ID (if applicable) or VAT self-cert for reverse-charge treatment
- Company tax ID (U.S. EIN or equivalent)
- Remit-to banking details (IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, beneficiary) and whether you accept wire or ACH for EUR payments
- Billing email and preferred invoice PDF/XML schema (we support human PDF or e-invoice XML)
- Copy of signed MSA (we can accept DocuSign)

Two procurement specifics to note: we require PO number on all invoices to match payment automation (our PO acceptance is strict), and our default payment term is net-60 from invoice receipt unless otherwise agreed in a signed SOW. If you have any early-payment discount preferences, please flag them.

Attached: Hydrolytics_AP_Form.pdf (fillable), onboarding-checklist.pdf

Can you complete the AP form and send the documents back by EOD Tuesday? If you prefer, we can also create a portal invite for supplier tokenization — let me know.

Thanks,
Nisha Rao
Senior AP Specialist
Hydrolytics Finance

From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: Nisha Rao <nisha.rao@hydrolytics.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-07T10:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment request — Redwood Inference (AP onboarding)

Hi Nisha — thanks for the clear checklist and the form. We're happy to proceed. Looping in Laura (finance) and Karthik (ops) to confirm the specifics below.

Quick answers up front:
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- U.S. EIN: 81-3456789
- We are a U.S. entity; we do not currently have an EU VAT registration. We can provide a VAT self-cert for reverse-charge where applicable — attaching a draft.

Questions for you / confirmation items:
1) PO handling: you mentioned strict PO matching — do you allow a short grace window for first invoice (we have one-time set-up items that historically need a manual payment if PO isn't in the system the same day)?
2) Remit options: we can accept EUR wires (IBAN/SWIFT) — do you require payments to a EUR-denominated account for EU vendors, or will USD wire to our US bank be accepted?
3) Invoice format: we can produce PDF (human) and UBL XML. Which do your automated rules prefer for new vendors?

Attachments from our side: Prelim_Invoice_Sample.pdf (sample invoice with PO field), Redwood_Bank_Instructions.csv (IBAN/SWIFT and beneficiary formatting), Redwood_EU_VAT_Self-Cert.pdf (draft).

Next steps for us: Laura will complete the AP form and sign the MSA if needed. Karthik — can you confirm whether Redwood needs to be set as PO-exempt or tokenized in the Hydrolytics portal for the initial deployment?

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Nisha Rao <nisha.rao@hydrolytics.io>
Date: 2026-11-07T11:23:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment request — Redwood Inference (AP onboarding)

Chloe / Nisha — adding Redwood finance checklist below so Hydrolytics has everything it needs in one shot.

Redwood finance checklist for Hydrolytics AP record:
- Completed AP form (fillable PDF) — I will fill and sign 
- W-9 / EIN confirmation (attached) — for US tax reporting, but see VAT thread for EU treatment
- Remit-to bank details: we can provide EUR IBAN + SWIFT or USD ACH/wire. Preference for EU clients is to bill in EUR into a EUR account to avoid conversion delays; we can provide both.
- Invoice header requirements: company legal name, invoice number, invoice date, PO number (if present), list of taxable line items with currency and gross/net values, and a Billing contact email.
- Payment terms: default net-45 for commercial deals with Redwood, but we can accept Hydrolytics’ net-60 for this engagement if that’s the contractual baseline. Please confirm in writing.
- Early-pay options: we offer a 1.5% discount for net-15 payment; note this requires a separate early-pay addendum.

I will complete the Hydrolytics_AP_Form.pdf and return as "Completed_AP_Form_Filled.pdf". Karthik, anything else on the ops/integration side?

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Nisha Rao <nisha.rao@hydrolytics.io>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@hydrolytics.io
Date: 2026-11-07T14:02:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment request — Redwood Inference (AP onboarding)

Laura / Chloe — thanks, helpful. A few clarifications from procurement/AP on Hydrolytics' side: 

- PO matching: our automation requires PO number on the invoice for straight-through processing. If the PO is missing, the invoice routes to a manual queue which typically delays payment by ~2 invoice cycles. We can grant a one-time manual exception for the onboarding invoice, but we will need the LPO (procurement approval) to mark Redwood as "Pending" for subsequent releases.
- Currency/remit: Hydrolytics prefers to pay EU vendors in EUR to local EURO accounts, but we do accept USD wires to the US if that is Redwood's only option. Please provide both bank options if available.
- VAT: For services procured from non-EU suppliers, Hydrolytics applies reverse-charge when a valid VAT self-cert is present. If Redwood later registers for VAT in the EU, update our vendor record and we will change the tax handling.
- Invoice format: PDF is fine for now. For e-invoicing (XML), we will onboard you to our e-invoice endpoint after the vendor record is created (we can provide a test endpoint).
- MSA: Please sign and return the MSA; attached is the DocuSign link we referenced: https://docusign.com/Redwood-MSA-8382. Procurement needs the signed MSA on file to finalize net-60 acceptance.

Attachments included on our side: Hydrolytics_AP_Form.pdf (fillable)

If you can return the AP form plus bank details and the signed MSA by EOD tomorrow we will create the vendor record and send a portal invite.

Best,
Nisha

From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: Nisha Rao <nisha.rao@hydrolytics.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Bcc: accounts-payable@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-07T17:35:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment request — Redwood Inference (AP onboarding)

Nisha — thanks for the quick clarifications. Summary and next steps from Redwood: 

1) Completed form + bank details attached (Completed_AP_Form_Filled.pdf; Redwood_Bank_Instructions.csv). We provided both EUR IBAN/SWIFT and USD wire details.
2) VAT handling: attached Redwood_EU_VAT_Self-Cert.pdf (draft). We do not currently have an EU VAT registration; please configure reverse-charge treatment per your process once you accept the self-cert.
3) MSA: signed via DocuSign (MSA-Redwood-DocuSign.pdf) — HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8382.
4) Invoice format: we will start with the attached Prelim_Invoice_Sample.pdf (PDF) and enable UBL XML once Hydrolytics confirms e-invoice endpoint.

Action items we need from Hydrolytics:
- Confirm whether the onboarding invoice will be eligible for the one-time manual exception if PO creation lags (we need confirmation so SOW work can proceed without payment hold-up).
- Send supplier portal invite/token so Karthik can complete the e-invoice test if needed.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
